student_learning_goal: I can give and follow movement directions with turns.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can give and follow movement directions with turns.
header.character_watermark: Compass Coco the Cat in the top-right with a treasure map and compass. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Start at A. Follow each direction. Mark where you END.
parts.visual_layout: A 6x6 map grid with start and end markers and three direction strips.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 map grid for geometry worksheet, B&W line art. 6x6 grid with A marked at top-left and 4 treasure spots scattered. Below: 3 direction strips like '3 right + quarter turn + 2 forward'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P1_GRID at Part 1: keywords name the grid map and directions strips.

parts.answer_key: Each route lands on the marked treasure spot.

parts.student_instructions: For 4 turn arrows, write QUARTER or HALF.
parts.visual_layout: Four arrow icons showing different turn amounts and a labelled answer line beside each.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 turn identification layout for geometry worksheet, B&W line art. 4 arrow icons showing 90 degree right, 180 degree, 90 degree left, 180 degree turns. Each with a label line.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P2_TURNS at Part 2: keywords name the arrow icons and turn types.

parts.student_instructions: Write a 4-step direction with at least 1 turn. Test it.
parts.visual_layout: Direction-writing lines and a small grid for testing the route.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 3 route writing layout for geometry worksheet, B&W line art. 4 lines for direction steps. Below: small 4x4 grid for testing.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P3_WRITE at Part 3: keywords name the route writing and testing space.

parts.answer_key: Any valid 4-step direction with at least 1 turn.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, design a treasure-hunt route with 5 steps and 2 turns.
teacher_notes: Lesson 4 consolidation. Formative — check turn type identification.
